comparison_method: Manual semantic review of all six greedy and six sampled chat serving answers against prompt-correct HF and standalone TT controls. The common vLLM prompt file and full-model prompt file have identical SHA256 values. Controls validate prompt interpretation and early answer trajectory; final serving outputs are judged for coherence, topic, repetition, gibberish, wrong-language drift, and request contamination.
